title: Beyond Statistical Patterns: Integrating Textual Domain Knowledge with Causal Discovery for Calibrated Uncertainty Estimation

contributions.purpose: 融合文本领域知识与统计因果发现以改进校准
contributions.mechanism: reliability-weighted ensemble:GPT-4 描述知识 + 6 种统计方法,经可靠性加权 log-odds 融合 + 温度缩放校准
contributions.domain: 因果发现 / 不确定性量化
contributions.source_quote: Calibration-Focused Integration Framework: Systematic integration of textual domain knowledge with statistical causal inference that achieves 59% reduction in calibration error while improving accuracy from 93.1% to 94.4%.

contributions.purpose: 在保持校准的同时扩大高置信预测覆盖
contributions.mechanism: 多证据融合 + 系统一致性,按置信分层输出
contributions.source_quote: Coverage Expansion with Calibrated Uncertainty: Quantitative evidence that multi-evidence integration expands high-confidence prediction coverage to 66% of pairs while maintaining calibrated confidence estimates.

contributions.purpose: 提供可靠性加权集成方法学
contributions.mechanism: 证据加权 R=α·Acc+β·(1-σ)+γ·(1-DECE),系统一致性 + 温度缩放
contributions.source_quote: Reliability-Weighted Ensemble Methodology: Principled framework for evidence weighting, systematic consensus, and temperature-scaled calibration that transforms uncertain individual predictions into reliable consensus decisions.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Rather than viewing LLMs as standalone causal inference systems, we treat them as domain knowledge extractors that process textual descriptions to complement statistical methods applied to numerical data.

notes: 有自声明四条贡献列表(取核心 3 条)。负结果/弱结果:头条准确率提升相对基线其实不显著——McNemar Ensemble vs Description-only p=0.387(不显著),68 pair 上仅 63-5;真正显著的只是相对'best statistical'和随机(p<0.001)。统计基线方法个体准确率仅 50-61.8%,'贡献 74% 证据'的说法建立在弱个体之上。数据红旗:6.3 节称'physical sciences best / social sciences largest improvement'的按域分解,但数据仅 72 Tübingen pairs,未见对应分域表,疑为无支撑外推。checklist D/C/D/D——文本主由 AI 写、框架由'Claude AI'实现、文献/分析由'Liner Pro AI',称'scientific conclusions were primarily AI-generated';AI 自认局限:统计记号偶有不一致。reject。
